title: English Conversation 43:  A Big Stain
content: 1. a stain: a spot caused by dropping or getting a thing on something else - I have a chocolate stain on my shirt. - I spilled spaghetti sauce on my pants and now there is a big stain. 2. get a stain out: to remove a spot from something - Can you get this stain out of my shirt? - How do you get a mustard stain out? 3. dry cleaners: a business that dry-cleans clothes and garments - I need to pick up my shirts from the dry cleaners. - Do you take your clothes to the dry cleaners?
